batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2020-2021, Set-B — full 60-question paper (60-question format) transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.57-59 (questions; printed answer table on p.59; printed worked solutions pp.59-60). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper (only 'Short Syllabus' and 'Extra Syllabus' boxes); subject blocks by printed layout/content: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, General Knowledge Q7-12, Physics Q13-27, Chemistry Q28-44, Higher Mathematics Q45-60. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.57 carries Q1-16, 19-21, 23-25; p.58 carries Q26-27, 29-36, 38-42, 45, 47-48, 50, 53-55, 57-58 plus Q17-18 under the 'Extra Syllabus' box; p.59 carries Q22, 28, 37, 43-44, 46, 49, 51-52, 56, 59-60 above the answer table. The answer table prints a dash at Q42 only; there are no dual keys. Q42's printed worked solution (p.60) leaves its key slot literally blank ('সমাধান: (blank)') and computes [H+] = 10^-10 M, which is not among the printed options; because the book nowhere explicitly declares 'no correct option', Q42 is recorded with correctOptionIds null and answerVerificationStatus 'unknown' and NO answerDisposition is claimed. Worked solutions are printed for 31 questions (03, 04, 13, 15, 19, 21, 24, 29-33, 36 on p.59; 42 (blank key), 45, 47, 48, 50, 53-55, 57, 58 on p.60; and 18, 22, 46, 49, 52, 56, 59, 60 under the 'Extra Syllabus' solutions on p.60); every printed solution letter agrees with the answer table. One flagged remark: Q52's printed solution adds that with a base-e logarithm both (a) and (b) would be correct, while the table keys only (b) — the table key is recorded and the remark is preserved in Q52's extraction note. Preserved print anomalies: Q43(b) prints '3CaCO.SiO2' (apparent misprint for 3CaO.SiO2); Q12's stem prints the year in Bengali digits (২০২১) against Latin-digit options; a stray print speck precedes 'টেনে' in Q15's stem. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 37 of 60 questions verified. Q13: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) Q15: excluded (DIFFER) Q18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) Q28: excluded (DIFFER) Q30: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) Q34: excluded (DIFFER) Q37: excluded (DIFFER) Q45: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q46: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q47: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q48: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q49: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q50: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q51: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q52: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q53: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q54: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q55: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q56: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q57: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q58: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q59: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT) Q60: excluded (NOT_ON_SATT)

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-B of JU A Unit 2020-2021 occupies book PDF pp.57-60 (printed book pp.56-59): questions pp.57-59, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') on p.59, printed worked solutions pp.59-60 including an 'Extra Syllabus' subsection on p.60. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page (zoomed re-reads for the answer table, Q3/Q4 spellings, Q14-Q15, Q20-Q24, Q32-Q35, Q37-Q46, Q42/Q45/Q47, Q49-Q60 and the Q17/Q18 'Extra Syllabus' box); mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices as [[... , ...], ...], vectors as A→ with î/ĵ/k̂ unit vectors, combinations as ^nC_r).
